name: Calf Muscle Strain
definition: Acute injury of gastrocnemius or soleus musculotendinous tissue causing calf pain, often during acceleration or push-off.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is selective, while vascular ultrasound is used when DVT is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent swelling or thrombotic risk requires vascular reassessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Jangha/Mamsa-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Acute injury of gastrocnemius or soleus musculotendinous tissue causing calf pain, often during acceleration or push-off.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
